description: Browse the DocStar API reference one level at a time, when no dedicated tool on this server does what the user needs. Call it with {} for the top level: the modules (Collections, Pages, Endpoints, Published Versions, MCP Server, FAQs, Changelogs, Webhooks, URL Mappings, ...) with a short description and the endpoints they hold. Call it with `path` set to a module's link to see inside it, and with an endpoint's link ending in ".openapi.yml" to get that endpoint as an OpenAPI file: method, url, headers, query params, path variables, a body example and sample responses. Fetch only the level you need, and reuse what you already fetched.

path.description: A link from a listing, exactly as given (e.g. "https://docs.example.com/sms/llms.txt" or ".../sms/send-sms.openapi.yml"), or just the path ("sms", "sms/send-sms.openapi.yml"). Leave it out for the top level.

name: get_docstar_api_docs
